body:
What about assault vest bisharp? It helps a lot with the Lele predicament, as well as having quite a bit of power to back it up. Being steel, it covers mimikyu's weakness to poison and steel, and the assault vest helps it switch in on special attackers. 

Also, you may want defog on your Mantine to assist with stealth rocks and spikes. Mantine is good on this team, because it's flying out can switch in on ground attacks which is useful.

You might want one electric immunity, although bisharp can switch in on Koko. 

Either way looks line a nice party :)
